scope: Five prioritized catalog workflow families; independent real API and browser outcomes.

genericSkillChecker.setup: Existing disable-model-invocation property is unsupported by the generic checker; unchanged base metadata passes repository validation.

interpretation: Results span different candidate skill snapshots and oracle revisions; there is no aggregate success rate.
A strict pass is only an execution diagnostic. Correct outcomes require independent assertions; recovered command failures remain recorded.
Rechecks are not additional model trials. Visual rechecks change only fixture coordinates explicitly supplied in the original prompt.
All runs used an uncommitted candidate based on baseRevision. The copied skill manifest and harness digests distinguish exact evaluated snapshots.
SHA-256 values identify retained local evidence; raw transcripts and workspaces remain private and are not included in this report.
The initial plugin result predates the separate oracle manifest field. That digest is null; later rechecks record the oracle manifest explicitly.
boundaries: Plugin and embedded preview checks use real SDK/controller code with controlled iframe hosts, not the hosted CMS editor.
Visual editing is tested in Next.js and Chrome; no new complete browser flow is claimed for Nuxt, SvelteKit or Astro.
The import scenario covers CSV and local assets, not WordPress or Contentful importer integration.
Migration scenarios do not promote environments. No production deployment, CDN purge, provider matrix or all-model reliability claim is made.
Small samples cover these workflows; they do not establish perfect reliability or coverage of every catalog feature.

Preview mapping now reads the correct raw relationship, but a disabled client subscription still received a draft token on the public page. The independent credential assertion failed and temporary tokens were revoked during verified cleanup.

NextURL normalized 127.0.0.1 to localhost during an absolute redirect, changing the browser cookie host and losing draft mode. Installed framework source confirmed this behavior; the fixture now consistently uses localhost.
